findings.title: NRL.com's own R1 wrap disagrees with itself on Tonga's margin
findings.text: The official wrap's scoreline is Tonga 30-12 England (+18) at HBF Park, Perth, but its standings paragraph lists Tonga on +12. Separately, the R2 late mail calls it 'last week's historic win over Tonga' when the opponent was England. The result itself (a Tonga win) is consistent across both pages, so the M0195 fixture stands; the numbers above are quoted exactly as the official pages print them.

findings.title: Canonical M0240 text put Samoa-France in the wrong city
findings.text: The templated canonical prediction says Samoa beat France 78-4 'in Perth'; the NRL's official report and wrap both place the match at CommBank Stadium, Sydney. The S2 replacement prediction uses Sydney.

findings.title: Four High totals/handicap picks have no matching published price line
findings.text: M0162 picks Under 6.5 but the row publishes only 5.5 total lines; M0231 picks Over 5.5 but publishes only 6.5 lines; M0232 picks Under 6.5 but publishes only 5.5 lines; M0301 picks Toronto +0.5 but publishes Toronto -0.5. The fixtures are live-confirmed; the pick prices cannot be placed in the -250/+10000 window. Owner: Build E / pipeline data.

findings.title: Seven High moneyline picks have no originated moneyline price
findings.text: M0129, M0163, M0197, M0203, M0205, M0206 and M0248 (all Build G) publish an empty win market, so the High moneyline pick cannot be placed in the -250/+10000 window. Side markets exist (handicap/total on the six rugby rows, a total on M0129). Owner: Build G data.

findings.title: Historical High templated row has no replacement (match date passed)
findings.text: M0071 (RK Partizan AdmiralBet v FC Porto, handball, 21 Oct) is High with templated copy, but it predates the review boundary, so S2 authors no replacement pick for it.

findings.title: Master NHL dates use the UTC convention (often local date + 1)
findings.text: Every NHL master date matches the game's startTimeUTC date, while the NHL's own gameDate/gameCenter link uses the venue-local date. Example: WPG@DAL is local 22 Oct but UTC 23 Oct (M0189); TOR@CGY and DET@EDM are local 26 Oct but UTC 27 Oct (M0301/M0302). Verified systematically: all 34 live-checked NHL rows follow this rule. It is a convention, not an error, but readers comparing with NHL.com local listings must know it.

findings.title: Thin coverage at the window edge: most of the 27 Oct NHL slate is missing
findings.text: The NHL plays 11 games on 27 Oct local; the master carries one (M0303 CBJ@PHI) plus two 26 Oct-local games dated 27 Oct by the UTC convention. Nothing is carried past 27 Oct except November rugby. A refresh session should extend or explicitly bound the window.

findings.title: Possible cross-build World Series duplication across date conventions
findings.text: Build D rows (M0164 G1 23 Oct; M0282 'Game 3' 26 Oct) overlap Build E rows (M0210 24 Oct, M0252 25 Oct, M0293 27 Oct) in a way consistent with the same games being recorded under different (local vs UTC) date conventions. S2 did not re-read MLB pages; carried as-is.

findings.title: Possible duplicate NBA rows a day apart (76ers-Cavaliers, Hawks-Rockets)
findings.text: M0131 (76ers v Cavaliers, 22 Oct) and M0253 (Hawks v Rockets, 25 Oct, no confidence) sit alongside same-matchup rows on adjacent dates (M0214 Cavaliers v Nets is distinct; M0211 Hawks v Rockets 24 Oct vs M0253 25 Oct is the suspicious pair). S2 did not re-read NBA pages; carried as-is for a basketball owner to reconcile.

findings.title: Golf pseudo-fixture misclassified as a head-to-head match
findings.text: M0147 ('FedEx Fall vs winning score typically -15 to -18') is a market note, not a fixture, and carries no source. Held as unverified; the integration owner should re-type it.

findings.title: M0124 names a non-EuroLeague side and has no source
findings.text: Anadolu Efes v Besiktas is presented as a basketball fixture but Besiktas is not a EuroLeague team and the row records no source URL. Held as unverified (also flagged by S1).

findings.title: M0266's canonical link is a generic schedule page, not the match page
findings.text: The row links https://www.nhl.com/schedule/2026-10-21 for a 25 Oct game. The matchup itself is live-confirmed (FLA@CHI, game 2026020180, United Center). Link precision only.

findings.title: Live re-check coverage is disclosed, not total
findings.text: S2 live-confirmed 30/30 current High fixtures, 34/36 NHL rows, 16/16 darts ties, 5/9 rugby league rows, and 19/29 rugby union rows (14 confirmed + 5 corroborated). NBA, MLB, cricket, handball, volleyball, golf, women's RL, PREM rugby and November internationals are carried from their builds' verified pipeline data and were not live re-read.

findings.title: M0178 sits 6 cents from the focus-window edge
findings.text: Jonny Clayton at 1.41 converts to -244, just inside the -250 boundary. Any re-price at -250 or shorter would move it out of the requested focus range.

findings.title: URC kickoff times render in the reader's locale; S2 asserts dates/venues only
findings.text: The URC match centre states 'All times shown are Local'. S2 confirms matchups, dates and venues from that page and does not assert timezone conversions.
